title: fix(providers): send --temperature and --top_p in chat completion requests

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package openai
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/aandrew-me/tgpt/v2/src/structs"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func requestBodyFor(t *testing.T, params structs.Params) map[string]any {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	var body map[string]any
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		raw, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &body))
+	}))
+	defer server.Close()
+
+	params.Url = server.URL
+	resp, err := NewRequest("hello", params)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	resp.Body.Close()
+
+	return body
+}
+
+func TestRequestCarriesTemperatureAndTopP(t *testing.T) {
+	body := requestBodyFor(t, structs.Params{Temperature: "0.2", Top_p: "0.9"})
+
+	assert.Equal(t, 0.2, body["temperature"])
+	assert.Equal(t, 0.9, body["top_p"])
+}
+
+func TestRequestLeavesOutUnsetSampling(t *testing.T) {
+	body := requestBodyFor(t, structs.Params{})
+
+	assert.NotContains(t, body, "temperature")
+	assert.NotContains(t, body, "top_p")
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+package structs
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+)
+
+func TestSamplingOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	temperature, topP := Params{Temperature: "0.2", Top_p: "0.9"}.SamplingOptions()
+	assert.Equal(t, 0.2, *temperature)
+	assert.Equal(t, 0.9, *topP)
+
+	temperature, topP = Params{Temperature: "0"}.SamplingOptions()
+	assert.Equal(t, 0.0, *temperature)
+	assert.Nil(t, topP)
+
+	temperature, topP = Params{Temperature: "warm", Top_p: ""}.SamplingOptions()
+	assert.Nil(t, temperature)
+	assert.Nil(t, topP)
+}
